Evidence collection was corrected to accept Rust harness text before fixture markers and exclude result directories ending in .py from driver hashes. It reused the unchanged test logs.
remaining: Retained Windows changeUri 100.250 ms failure against unchanged 50 ms limit remains unexplained.
Backend measurements do not distinguish admission, owner queueing, persistence, publication or scheduling.
Native Linux mixed-BT/io_uring/strict Unix filesystem, instrumented Rust std/harness TSan, macOS/MSVC, fresh/minimum OS, final matrix, hardware power loss and compatibility gates remain open.
